xml_content: <TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex212-2025-01-081" status="finalized" part="M" next="ex21022025-10-0216-52-26">yang <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3786">blo gros chen po dag</rs> <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ref="db:3786" ana="corpusmd:named_reference">lo tsha ba</rs></note> <quote>'di 'gro ba 'dod dang 'gro ba yis<note type="editorial">Not a direct quote from the base text.</note></quote> | ces pa'i tshul gyis 'gro ba'i bya ba la dmigs pa'i blo rnam pa 2 po 'gro ba'i bya ba <choice><reg>nyams su</reg><orig>{°°}→nyams × su</orig></choice> ma myong pa'i dus na yod pa'i dod pa tsam dang | 'gro ba'i bya ba mngon du gyur pa'i dbye ba tha dad pa ltar | byang chub la dmigs pa'i blo 2 kyang smon pa <lb n="11b8"/> ni yul nyaMs su ma myong pa'i dus kyi 'dod pa tsam yin la | 'jug pa ni dmigs yul byang chub nyaMs su myong pa'i dus na yin pas de mthong laM skyes pa na yin te | des na smon pa ni yang dag pa blangs pa brda' las thob pa yin la | 'jug pa ni chos nyid kyis thob pa <expan>yin no</expan> zhes <expan>zer ro</expan> || </seg></TEI>
